_nguon: EN-ALL GĐ 7 — mẫu câu tiếng Anh cho trang kiến thức 78 lá Tarot (kb/trang_tarot.py). Ban biên tập viết từ nghĩa.
trang_tr.td.1: {ten} tarot card meaning: upright, reversed, love and work
trang_tr.td.2: {ten} tarot card meaning: upright and reversed
trang_tr.hinh: The picture on the card (Waite deck, 1909)
trang_tr.mien_tru_sk: A note on daily rhythm, not medical advice — it does not replace a doctor.
trang_tr.ct.doan: The Golden Dawn links {ten} to {ct} and the Hebrew letter {chu} (path {duong} on the Tree of Life); the Thoth deck calls it {thoth}, the Marseille deck {tdm_a}. Suggested rhythm: {nhip}. This rhythm is the Golden Dawn's way of tying a card to a season and a planet — a hint for choosing when to act, not a predicted date.
trang_tr.decan.doan: Book T (Golden Dawn) links {ten} to decan {so} of {cung} ({ngay}), ruled by {ht}; Sephirah {seph}; Golden Dawn title: {thoth}. Rhythm of the suit of {bo}: {nhip}. A decan is a suggested rhythm (each covers about 10 days, and the usual dates shift by a day depending on the year), not a predicted date.
trang_tr.goc.tieu_de: Root of the suit and timing
trang_tr.goc.doan: {ten} is the {thoth} — the root of every card of {bo}; Sephirah {seph}. An Ace has no decan of its own; it follows the rhythm of the suit of {bo}: {nhip} (a hint, not a prediction).
trang_tr.hg.tieu_de: Court card: double element and timing
trang_tr.hg.doan: The Golden Dawn reads {ten} as {ntp} ({thoth}); the Marseille deck calls it {tdm_a}. As a person: {nv} As a situation: {th}. Rhythm of the suit of {bo}: {nhip}.
trang_tr.viec: What to do when you draw this card
trang_tr.hd.bo: Which suit and element does {ten} belong to?
trang_tr.hd.diem: Is drawing this card an omen?
trang_tr.hd.diem_dap: No. Here tarot is a way of looking again at one situation through pictures and four schools with written sources; a card names what is already there so you can see it clearly. It does not tell the future.
trang_tr.mo_ta: {ten} tarot card: {tk}; reversed: {ng}. Its meaning in love, work and money according to Waite, the Golden Dawn, Marseille and B.O.T.A.
